articles.title: Fossils from Haitian Cave Identified as Snipe Rather Than Woodcock
articles.summary: Researchers at the Florida Museum of Natural History have reidentified fossils from a Haitian cave as belonging to an extinct snipe species rather than a woodcock.
articles.content: A surprising twist has emerged in the study of long-distance bird migration, with researchers at the Florida Museum of Natural History making a significant discovery about an extinct bird species from Hispaniola. The story began with a woodcock that was identified as such in 2015 based on fossils excavated by museum researchers in 1984 from a Haitian cave. However, further analysis has revealed a surprising truth - these fossils were not actually of a woodcock but rather of a snipe. Woodcocks and snipes are closely related birds that share a common ancestor who lived around 25 million years ago. They can often be mistaken for one another due to their similarities in appearance. The misidentified snipe had short wings and big legs, characteristics commonly found in island birds compared to its closest relatives. A new study published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences has shed light on this discovery by sequencing ancient DNA from the fossil specimens. This analysis revealed that the fossils were indeed of a snipe rather than a woodcock. The research team's findings are significant because they challenge previous assumptions about the identity of these fossils. The team's efforts have also raised questions about migration and evolution in birds, particularly those species known for their long-distance flights across hemispheres. The study's lead researcher, Min Zhao, noted that the whole story began with an extinct bird from Hispaniola. However, it is not just this particular species that has sparked interest among scientists but rather the broader implications of its migration patterns and evolutionary history. Further analysis of these findings will provide valuable insights into the complex relationships between birds, their habitats, and the environments they inhabit during long-distance migrations. The incredible journey of shorebirds continues to fascinate scientists, as new discoveries reveal the remarkable feats of endurance achieved by these birds during their long-distance migrations. Study coauthor David Steadman, a renowned expert in ornithology, notes that shorebirds are the ultimate champions of long-distance migration. These birds can travel thousands of kilometers without stopping, with some species undertaking journeys of over 10,000 kilometers from their Arctic breeding grounds to their South American wintering sites. One remarkable example of this endurance is the bristle-thighed curlew, which was tracked by researchers using radio tags and found to have flown an astonishing 6,200 miles (10,000 km) without rest. This feat is all the more impressive given that these birds are capable of covering such vast distances in a relatively short period. In addition to curlews, other shorebird species such as woodcocks and snipes also undertake long-distance migrations. However, unlike many other shorebirds, some woodcock and snipe species have opted out of migration altogether, instead choosing to establish resident populations on islands around the world. It is estimated that there are eight living species of woodcock, with six of these being endemic to island habitats. This phenomenon has led some researchers to suggest that the migratory propensity of these birds may be linked to their ability to colonize new areas. According to Steadman, the unique behavior of woodcocks and snipes is a fascinating area of study, with these birds having radiated across various regions including the Caribbean, Japan, Indonesia, and the western Pacific. Their ability to establish resident populations on islands has allowed them to thrive in environments that would be inhospitable to many other shorebird species. The team behind this research collected tissue samples from museums across the country for analysis, with DNA extracted and sequenced by Jessica Oswald, a postdoctoral researcher at the time. The study's findings have significant implications for our understanding of the evolution and radiation of woodcock and snipe species over the past quarter-million years. The researchers took a novel approach by combining fossil ages with DNA data to create a time-calibrated phylogeny of shorebird species. This method allowed them to reconstruct the evolutionary history of these birds over millions of years with greater precision than ever before. Some team members have experience in this type of research, having conducted similar studies in the past. One coauthor's previous work involved extracting ancient DNA from fossil specimens while working at a major museum in Florida. In recent years, the researchers have made several significant discoveries about the history of island species. Their findings include evidence that humans intentionally introduced large rodents to the Bahamas over 1,000 years ago for food. Another discovery challenged long-held assumptions about the origins of birds in certain regions. A study found that a group of extinct Caribbean birds were more closely related to species from New Zealand and Africa than those living on the American continent. The woodcock's journey to North America is not remarkable by itself. However, when considering the proximity of modern-day Russia and Alaska, it becomes clear that dispersal from Asia was a plausible route, with Iceland and Greenland also providing suitable stopovers for birds crossing from Europe. In contrast, the snipe's journey from Eurasia to South America defies conventional migration patterns. The bird deviated significantly from its usual north-south route by veering west across an entire ocean, making this a truly extraordinary feat. Seven million years after the initial event, another instance of long-distance migration occurred when South American snipes repeated their predecessors' actions on an even grander scale. This time, they flew to the southwest Pacific islands and diversified into multiple species. The result was completely unexpected, with scientists initially classifying the South Pacific island austral snipes as a distinct genus called Coenocorypha. These birds appear remarkably different from their relatives in South America and Eurasia, earning them separate classification. However, further study revealed that despite their distinct appearance, the austral snipes are deeply embedded within a lineage of mostly South American snipes. This finding has significant implications for our understanding of these birds' evolutionary history. If we were to map out the genealogical relationships between these species, the austral snipes would appear as a rebellious sibling that ran away from its family and changed its name and appearance but still shares a common ancestry with them. The study's authors now face a dilemma when it comes to taxonomic classification. They must decide whether to merge the genus Coenocorypha into Gallinago or establish two new genera for the cousins living in South America, while keeping Coenocorypha intact. The idea of a trail of breadcrumbs left behind by ancient snipe species on Pacific islands is an intriguing one. These hypothetical ancestors would have been closely related and now extinct, much like other bird families such as the rails. Their presence on various islands could be seen as leaving behind a path for their descendants to follow, leading them eventually to New Zealand and its surrounding islands. However, this trail was not meant to last, as humans would soon arrive and consume these breadcrumbs in the form of endemic snipe species. It's a sad reality that people will eat anything they come across, including birds and other wildlife. In fact, explorers and whalers who stopped at Pacific islands would often hunt down entire bird communities in a short span of time due to hunger. This wasn't just an isolated incident, but rather a common practice during the 19th century, as described by naturalist Peter Matthiessen in his 1976 article for The New Yorker. He recounted how gunners would shoot thousands of birds in a single day, with some species being so trusting that they would circle back over the guns to look for their fallen companions. Recent studies have shed new light on the remarkable long-distance migration patterns of certain bird species. Researchers have found that these birds are capable of traveling vast distances without rest, often returning to their original habitats after years away. Their findings suggest that transoceanic dispersals and island extinctions have played a significant role in shaping global snipe and woodcock diversity. Some bird populations were able to colonize new areas, while others became extinct due to changes in their ecosystems. This complex interplay of factors has resulted in the remarkable diversity of these bird species today. Phys.org : https://phys.org/news/2026-11-avian-champions-distance-migration-scientists.html

articles.title: DirectX Diagnostic Tool Available on Windows Systems
articles.summary: The tool can help diagnose issues related to DirectX by scanning a computer and reporting on its technical specifications.
articles.content: Windows users may be unaware that a built-in tool can help diagnose issues related to DirectX, Microsoft's proprietary framework for graphics and audio processing. This tool, known as DxDiag, can scan a computer and report on its technical specifications, including installed DirectX components and drivers. It is particularly useful when troubleshooting problems with graphics or sound-related applications, which may fail to launch or crash if the system doesn't meet their requirements. Identifying the root cause of such issues can be challenging due to the potential involvement of outdated DirectX software, corrupt video card drivers or a faulty Windows configuration. In these cases, DxDiag can serve as a starting point for investigation and help narrow down the possible causes. The diagnostic tool is accessible through the Windows Run command by typing "dxdiag and pressing enter. Alternatively, users can search for it in the Start menu and launch it from there. Once open, DxDiag presents its findings in four sections: System, Display, Sound, and Input. Each section of the report provides detailed information about the computer's hardware and software configuration, including video card specifications, audio drivers, and input device settings. By examining these details, users can gain a better understanding of their system's capabilities and limitations. To maximize the usefulness of DxDiag, it is recommended that users enable the Check for WHQL digital signatures" option when running the tool. This feature verifies the integrity of installed drivers, helping to ensure that they are genuine and properly configured. The System page of your PC provides detailed information about its core components, including the motherboard, processor, memory, and graphics card. This section also displays the version of DirectX installed on your computer, which is crucial for running games and other graphics-intensive applications. In addition to the System page, the Display page offers a comprehensive overview of your graphics card's capabilities. It lists the driver version, supported DirectX features like Direct3D Acceleration and DirectX 12 Ultimate, and other relevant details. Reviewing this information can help you identify potential issues with your graphics setup. The Sound page provides information about connected audio devices and their drivers, while the Input page lists all input/output (IO) devices, including keyboards, mice, and other peripherals. When reviewing these pages, be sure to check the Notes section at the bottom for any reported errors or warnings from DxDiag. While DxDiag can help identify issues with display, sound, and input devices, it cannot conclusively determine whether your DirectX installation is corrupted. A clean report does not necessarily rule out all hardware and game-specific problems that your computer might be experiencing. If DxDiag reports errors related to display, sound, or IO devices, start by comparing the affected component's driver version with the latest available from the manufacturer's official website. If there's a discrepancy, consider downloading and installing the updated drivers to ensure compatibility and optimal performance. In some cases, audio-specific issues may be caused not just by outdated drivers but also by incorrect playback settings in the Windows sound panel. Verify that you're using the correct playback device and check if the affected application or game has a recent update or patch addressing hardware-related bugs. If you've tried all possible solutions but still encounter problems, running the sfc /scannow command with administrator privileges can scan and repair system files to potentially resolve issues. This process checks for any corrupted or missing system files that may be causing problems. System file corruption often leads to a range of symptoms including DirectX-related issues. If errors persist after attempting these troubleshooting steps, it's advisable to reach out to Microsoft support and share your DxDiag report, which can help their team identify the root cause of compatibility problems in your PC configuration. articles.title: Chinese Tech Sector Plummets 44% from Summer Peak
articles.summary: China's tech-heavy market has declined by 44% since its summer peak, outpacing a similar drop in the US Nasdaq index.
articles.content: The Chinese tech sector is experiencing a severe downturn, with the STAR 50 index plummeting by 44% from its summer peak. This decline is more pronounced than the 18% drop seen in the US Nasdaq index, which has been struggling despite a relatively better performance compared to China's tech-heavy market. The AI bubble, which has been a driving force behind China's economic growth, appears to have burst. The country's reliance on this sector has made it particularly vulnerable to market fluctuations. Analysts warn that the current situation poses significant risks for President Xi Jinping's plans to reinvigorate the economy through AI investments. China's property market, which accounts for a staggering 70% of household wealth, is facing a major crisis. The housing crash has resulted in deflationary pressures and weakened consumer demand. Business investment is also suffering, with property investment plummeting by nearly 22% in October. Beijing's strategy to mitigate the economic downturn involves leveraging cheap exports to boost growth. Additionally, state-backed banks have been pumping money into the stock market through a "national team of investors. This move aims to stabilize the market and prevent further instability. As President Xi Jinping hosts global leaders this week, his administration is grappling with the implications of the market's decline on its economic plans. The AI buildout, which was supposed to be financed by Chinese savers turned stock investors, now seems uncertain due to the downturn in the property market and declining business investment. Chinese stocks have been in free fall this year, weighed down by intense competition, increased tax burdens, higher energy costs, and tariffs that are making it harder for exports to compete on the global market. The risk of trading partners blocking Chinese goods sold at artificially low prices is also a major concern. The stability of China's stock market is crucial for maintaining funding for artificial intelligence initiatives. If the market remains in turmoil, AI projects may be forced into the state-owned enterprise sector, further limiting opportunities for private sector growth. This outcome would run counter to Xi Jinping's pledge to shrink the SOE universe since 2013. The government's crackdown on the tech sector in 2020 has left retail investors wary of putting their money into Chinese stocks. The perception that the market is rigged and favors well-connected insiders doesn't help, either. As a result, many households view investing as a high-stakes gamble rather than a way to build long-term wealth. The Shanghai Composite remains below its peak set in October 2007, despite China's GDP growing nearly sixfold since then. This has left many investors with financial PTSD" after repeated stock market crashes, including the severe downturn in 2015 that required significant government intervention. Despite being a global leader in AI, China still relies heavily on mom-and-pop investors to drive trade on its markets. However, even these small-scale investors are increasingly treating the market as a high-risk place to invest rather than a means of growing retirement savings. The Chinese government's efforts to stabilize its capital markets are a top priority for Premier Li Qiang, who has identified this goal as the most pressing issue for the remainder of the year. To achieve this aim, securities regulators have relaxed requirements for company buybacks and discouraged initial public offerings (IPOs) and large share sales. This move aims to prevent stock dilution and subsequent selloffs that can destabilize the market. However, a new threat has emerged in the form of technology curbs imposed by the Trump administration following a high-profile espionage scandal involving Nvidia. These restrictions target China's access to advanced U.S. chips and computing capacity. As analysts at Capital Economics have pointed out, these controls threaten to impede China's progress in developing its leading AI models and slow down the country's AI rollout, potentially undermining President Xi Jinping's ambitions for a Chinese version of Wall Street. articles.title: Raspberry Pi Connect Simplifies Remote Access
articles.summary: The Raspberry Pi team has developed a program called Raspberry Pi Connect that allows users to communicate with their Pi unit over the internet without needing port forwarding.
articles.content: Remote access to a Raspberry Pi can be a game-changer for home projects that require frequent checking or updates while away from the device. However, setting up a VNC service or SSH tunneling often involves port forwarding, which can be a hassle for beginners and a potential security risk. Raspberry Pi Connect is a program developed by the Raspberry Pi team that allows users to communicate with their Pi unit over the internet without the need for port forwarding. This tool works seamlessly even when you're outside your network, making it an ideal solution for remote access. The best part about Raspberry Pi Connect is its ease of use and compatibility. If your device is running Bookworm or a later version, Connect will work automatically with no additional setup required. However, older devices have limited options, but as long as you're running Pi OS or its Lite variant, setting up Connect is a straightforward process. Raspberry Pi Connect relies on WebRTC technology to establish a secure peer-to-peer connection between two web browsers. This eliminates the need for third-party software on your Pi unit and allows it to bypass strict firewalls and restricted NATs. Connecting to a Raspberry Pi remotely just got easier thanks to the free tool called Connect. This versatile tool offers two essential features: screen sharing and remote shell. With remote shell, you can open an SSH terminal directly in your browser, making it simple to run commands or monitor your device from anywhere. Screen sharing is another convenient feature that lets you turn your browser into a virtual desktop for your Pi unit. However, keep in mind that this function requires an active desktop session and will use the Pi's resources since it runs through a Wayland session. If you're using an older model, make sure to update your Pi OS before attempting to use the screen sharing feature. To get started with Connect, you'll need two basic things: the tool installed on your Raspberry Pi unit and a stable internet connection. The tool comes in two packages: full and lite. While the full package supports screen-sharing compatibility for devices connected to a display, the lite version is geared towards remote access only. Once you've installed either package using an SSH session, simply type "rpi-connect on to enable internet access. To access your Raspberry Pi remotely using Connect, navigate to connect.raspberrypi.com and sign in to your Pi account if you already have one. Alternatively, create a new account from the menu if you're just setting up. Once logged into your Pi account, link your device by following the specific instructions available on the Raspberry Pi website under the Get Started section. After linking, simply sign back into your account and select the Connect via" option to choose how you'd like to connect to your device, making any necessary changes as needed to keep your setup up-to-date. articles.summary: The Ohio State Buckeyes suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of the Nebraska Huskers on Saturday afternoon, effectively ending their College Football Playoff hopes.
articles.content: The Ohio State Buckeyes suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of the Nebraska Huskers on Saturday afternoon, effectively ending their College Football Playoff hopes. This setback marked the team's fourth loss of the season under coach Ryan Day. Historically, when Ohio State suffers four losses in a single season, it has been a harbinger for change within the coaching staff. The last instance this occurred was in 2011, during Luke Fickell's tenure as head coach. That year, the Buckeyes finished with a disappointing 6-7 record before Fickell was replaced by Urban Meyer. Ohio State has seen its share of coaching changes over the years, often preceded by underwhelming performances from the team. John Cooper's firing in 2000 after an 8-4 season is a notable example. Similarly, Woody Hayes' last season at the helm ended with a 7-4 record, paving the way for his eventual departure. Coach Ryan Day has been under scrutiny since taking over as head coach following Urban Meyer's departure. Although a national title in 2024 temporarily silenced some of the concerns about his job security, recent setbacks have reignited doubts about his performance. If Ohio State decides to fire Ryan Day after his fourth loss in 2026, they will have to pay a hefty price for his buyout. The coach has five years remaining on his contract, but instead of receiving a percentage of his remaining salary upon termination, he is entitled to a flat rate per year. This figure stands at $11.5 million annually, which would translate to a whopping $57.5 million if the Buckeyes were to part ways with Day after this season. This buyout clause makes Ohio State's situation unique, as they would be on the hook for one of the largest severance packages in college football history. Only Jimbo Fisher's $76 million buyout from Texas A&M surpasses this amount, but the Buckeyes' payment would still rank among the top programs capable of handling such a substantial financial burden. Day's ability to deflect criticism and maintain his position may depend on how he addresses recent setbacks, including the team's second-half collapse against Indiana. The coaching staff will need to provide convincing explanations for their struggles in order to alleviate concerns about Day's performance. The Buckeyes' decision to retain or fire Day will have significant financial implications, and it remains to be seen whether they can justify the massive buyout that would come with terminating his contract. The pressure on Ryan Day and Ohio State is palpable, especially given their resources and expectations. The Buckeyes' inability to compete at the top level in back-to-back seasons will undoubtedly lead to scrutiny of their coaching staff. To make a significant change, such as firing Day, would require identifying a clear upgrade over his leadership. With a $57.5 million buyout on the table, Ohio State must be convinced that they can find a better fit for the program. Day's impressive record with the Buckeyes (89-16) might earn him another season to turn things around. The coaching market is currently lacking in standout candidates, which could work in his favor despite the mounting pressure. Ultimately, it seems likely that Day will get another chance to right the ship in 2027, but he'll have no room for error after exhausting his goodwill this season. The discrepancy between the figures highlights the ongoing debate over the true extent of public involvement in these demonstrations. Cities across France witnessed tens of thousands of people taking to the streets, with one notable gathering occurring in central Paris's Place de la République square. A festive atmosphere prevailed as musicians played, food trucks sold their wares, and protesters donned costumes and held homemade signs. The protest movement, which began in mid-September when high school students demanded improved learning conditions, has since grown into a broader campaign against rising prices and inadequate public services. The issue of police brutality has also become a focal point for demonstrators. The diversity of protesters was evident in their flags and vests, which blended together trade union symbols, left-wing party emblems, student organisation logos, and Yellow Vest movement insignia. This eclectic mix marked a significant milestone for the Yellow Vests, now eight years past their initial protests that shook President Emmanuel Macron's government. In a poignant gesture, one group set up mock headstones to commemorate the demise of France's public services, including social security and education systems. The stark reminder of the state of these essential services was a powerful message, underscoring the struggles faced by citizens across various sectors. Manon Moret, general secretary of the students' union Unef, pointed out that young people in multiple countries are grappling with similar issues: precarity has become a widespread concern, forcing individuals to choose between basic needs like housing, healthcare, and food. This stark reality was evident in the placards held by protesters. Placards carried messages such as "I want to live, not survive" and "No to the licence to kill", referencing a recently adopted law that has been heavily criticised for increasing protection for law enforcement officers who use their weapons. The protests have been largely peaceful but have seen instances of fringe violence and accusations of police brutality. At least 31 people have suffered serious injuries at the hands of security forces since the protests began, according to an AFP count based on direct testimonies, victims' lawyers, and NGO records. Despite these incidents, authorities have yet to provide a comprehensive toll of injuries. The protests against the police law in France continued for a sixth consecutive Saturday, but this time around, the turnout was significantly lower than in previous weeks. Some cities reported smaller numbers of demonstrators taking to the streets, despite calls from unions and activists for more protests in the coming weeks. In Lille, Marseille, and Lyon, protesters marched peacefully, carrying signs and banners. However, not all demonstrations remained calm, as some individuals attempted to rally in areas that had been banned. Clashes broke out on the fringes of a few protests, with riot police facing off against demonstrators who set fire to vehicles and bins. Police responded by firing tear gas at the crowds, but overall, the situation was less intense than in previous weeks. Authorities had taken precautions ahead of time, anticipating potential troublemakers among the protesters. Despite some incidents of violence, many participants remained committed to their cause, with some expressing optimism that their efforts would eventually lead to positive change. As one protester noted, "If we take care of our young people, our students, we'll have a wonderful tomorrow and that's why I'm here." With more protests planned for the coming weeks, it remains to be seen whether the momentum will continue or begin to fade. articles.title: Unprecedented Material Properties Observed in Polymer Under Stress
articles.summary: A team led by Chenfeng Ke has made a breakthrough discovery about the behavior of materials under stress, developing a smart material that exhibits unprecedented properties such as memory and adaptability.
articles.content: A team led by Chenfeng Ke has made an unusual discovery about the behavior of materials under stress. While most substances tend to weaken over time, this group's innovative polymer appears to grow stronger with repeated bending and straining. According to Ke, their smart material exhibits properties that are unprecedented in the field: it can remember, adapt, learn, and even grow. The implications of such a discovery are vast and exciting, as researchers consider potential applications for this remarkable substance. The breakthrough was achieved through a combination of sugar crystals and polyethylene glycol, a compound commonly used in laxatives and other health products. This biodegradable blend forms a hydrogel, which is a flexible material capable of absorbing and retaining large amounts of water. The hydrogel exhibits remarkable properties when subjected to repeated bending. Instead of deteriorating, its strength and resilience increase. This phenomenon was observed during experiments where the material was flexed numerous times, a process that could potentially be mimicked in various real-world applications. At the heart of this hydrogel's exceptional performance lies cyclodextrin, a sugar-based compound with unique properties. When the polymer is stretched or bent, the cyclodextrin molecules slide into position to reinforce areas under strain, effectively adapting to the changing conditions. This dynamic response allows the material to maintain its integrity even in the face of repeated deformation. The hydrogel's ability to mimic biological materials has significant implications for medical applications. By emulating the properties of collagen, a protein found in skin and other connective tissues, this polymer could potentially be used to protect and repair damaged tissues. This approach draws inspiration from nature, where many remarkable smart materials can be found. Surgeons and orthopedic device manufacturers may find this material particularly appealing due to its biocompatibility with biological tissues. Its composition of sugar and polyethylene glycol makes it an attractive option for medical applications. The potential uses for this sugar-based hydrogel are numerous and varied, with applications in medical fields such as supporting artificial joints or repairing damaged tissues. In both cases, areas that don't experience stress or strain would remain soft and pliable, allowing the material to adapt to different situations. According to Ke, a chemist who has been working on this project, the material doesn't need to be rigid to function effectively in the body. "If you're putting material into a body, you don't necessarily want it to be completely rigid," he explained, emphasizing the importance of flexibility and adaptability. Ke acknowledges that his expertise lies in chemistry rather than medicine or medical device development, which is why he's eager to collaborate with experts from WashU Medicine and other institutions. We want to work with these specialists to explore the possibilities of this material, he said, hoping that their research will attract interest from investors and potential users. The team has so far produced small quantities of the new polymer, in tens of grams at a time, but they're confident that production can be scaled up once the concept is proven. With successful demonstrations under their belt, Ke and his team are now exploring ways to expand their research and make the material more widely available. The research team has successfully demonstrated that their sugar-based hydrogel material can be strengthened through repeated bending, rather than being worn down by it. This counterintuitive property suggests a range of potential applications for the material, which could be used to create self-healing structures or adaptive systems that respond to changing conditions. articles.title: Canada's bid to strengthen economic ties with China raises concerns among Taiwan officials
articles.summary: Taiwan's Deputy Foreign Minister Chen Ming-chi expressed worries about Prime Minister Mark Carney's efforts to improve relations with Beijing.
articles.content: Canada's bid to strengthen economic ties with China has raised concerns among Taiwan officials, who warn that such moves risk exposing Canada to Chinese economic coercion. At the Halifax International Security Forum, Taiwan's Deputy Foreign Minister Chen Ming-chi expressed his worries about Prime Minister Mark Carney's efforts to improve relations with Beijing. "We worry, he said in an interview. Chen emphasized that Taiwan has learned from its own experiences of dependence on China and is now urging caution. Chen praised Carney for highlighting the risks of economic coercion during a recent speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland. However, Chen questioned whether deepening ties with countries like China was wise when they do not share Canada's democratic values. According to Chen, Canada has its own history of dealing with Beijing's actions, particularly the detention of two Canadians - former diplomat Michael Kovrig and businessman Michael Spavor - on charges that were widely seen as politically motivated. You have your own history, he said. Chen's comments on Canada's trade relationship with China come as a warning, but also as a cautionary tale from Taiwan's own experience in reducing its economic dependence on Beijing. Taiwan has significantly reduced its reliance on Chinese markets after witnessing firsthand the consequences of being at the mercy of Beijing's trade restrictions. The country's exports to China and Hong Kong have decreased from nearly 44% of total exports in 2020 to around 27% last year, according to official figures. Chen pointed out that Taiwan's efforts to diversify its economy have been successful, with the share of outbound investment going to China plummeting from over 80% in 2010 to just 3.8% last year. This dramatic shift is a testament to Taiwan's ability to adapt and navigate complex trade relationships. Chen's statements about Beijing's tactics were blunt: They are very good at weaponizing interdependence, he said, highlighting the risks of being overly reliant on Chinese markets. His words serve as a reminder that Canada's own trade relationship with China is not without its challenges. The contrast between Taiwan and Canada's approaches to trade with China is striking. While Canada seeks to expand its ties with Beijing, Taiwan has taken steps to reduce its dependence on Chinese markets. Chen's warning about the risks of being too closely tied to China serves as a timely reminder for Canadian policymakers. Chen's scathing critique of China's propaganda machine highlights its ability to manipulate global perceptions. A recent photograph from the Shenzhen summit has been exploited by Beijing to showcase Xi Jinping as the world leader, seated prominently between Trump and Putin. This move is seen as a calculated attempt to project Chinese dominance, with Chen describing it as more symbolic than substantial. He also warned that China's military operations around Taiwan are intensifying, despite the significant costs of an invasion. This includes rehearsing maritime quarantine tactics, which could have far-reaching implications for the self-governing island. Despite his concerns about Beijing's actions, Chen expressed admiration for Carney's international leadership and welcomed the commitment to sign a long-delayed trade cooperation arrangement with Taiwan. He praised Carney's vision, stating that We have a high respect of Prime Minister Carney's vision. And we want to be part of this vision." articles.title: Mercedes-Benz EQS 580 4MATIC Features Largest Infotainment Screen in a Car
articles.summary: A new trend in car infotainment is emerging, with screens getting bigger to accommodate a wide range of functions. Gone are the days of physical buttons; today's cars rely on Android Auto...
articles.content: A new trend in car infotainment is emerging, with screens getting bigger to accommodate a wide range of functions. Gone are the days of physical buttons; today's cars rely on Android Auto and Apple CarPlay-powered screens that display everything from GPS navigation to music controls. These screens have become essential for drivers and passengers alike, offering seamless connectivity and entertainment options. As their importance grows, so do the screens themselves, with some reaching enormous proportions that stretch nearly from one side of the dashboard to the other. The Mercedes-Benz EQS 580 4MATIC boasts an impressive 56-inch infotainment screen, making it the largest available in any car. This massive screen is actually comprised of three separate displays, each situated under a single glass panel that spans the entire dash. Mercedes-Benz calls this innovative display the Hyperscreen, and it's packed with an array of functions that cater to both standard controls and specialized features. The screen's enormous size allows for multiple tasks to be displayed simultaneously, ensuring that drivers have all the information they need at their fingertips. The Hyperscreen's zero-layer interface is a key feature that sets it apart from other infotainment systems. This intuitive system adjusts the apps displayed in real-time based on various factors, such as time of day and user preferences. This approach aims to streamline navigation by providing drivers with exactly what they need when they need it. The Hyperscreen's expansive display is not limited to the driver's field of view. Instead, it extends to the passenger seat, where an additional screen awaits. This setup allows passengers to access media features without interfering with the main navigation display. Passengers can watch YouTube videos or plan routes on their own screen before sending those instructions to the driver. The system also supports seven customizable profiles for each passenger seat, enabling individuals to tailor what appears on their screen by default. A built-in sensor is designed to minimize distractions by detecting when the driver looks at the passenger screen and automatically dimming or turning it off. However, some reviewers have questioned whether this feature is effective in real-world driving scenarios. Despite Mercedes-Benz's efforts to create a user-friendly interface with its zero-layer design, critics argue that navigating the system can still be frustrating at times. The use of all-capacitive controls has been particularly problematic for some users, who find it difficult to interact with the screen in practical situations. The large touchscreen in the Mercedes EQS 580 is prone to collecting fingerprints, which can make it difficult to use. This issue is exacerbated by the lack of physical buttons and controls on the Hyperscreen, making navigation a challenge for some drivers. A bigger infotainment screen may seem appealing, but it can also create problems with usability, particularly in situations where precision is key. Despite its impressive tech, the EQS 580's touchscreen experience falls short in practical applications. Engadget : https://www.engadget.com/2318759/largest-car-infotainment-touchscreen/

articles.summary: Reports are emerging of a growing concern within FEMA about a recent surge in network outages across various sectors, with officials questioning whether these outages are merely coincidental or part of a larger issue.
articles.content: Reports are emerging of a growing concern within the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) about the recent surge in network outages across various sectors. Officials at FEMA are questioning whether these outages are merely coincidental or part of a larger issue. Two officials have spoken out about their worries, citing the unusual scale and proximity of the disruptions. The unprecedented nature of the outages has left many experts baffled, with one official describing it as "scary and noting the lack of leadership in addressing the crisis. The Federal Emergency Management Agency declined to comment on the matter when approached for a response. As the situation unfolds, Americans are already on edge following the launch of FORTRESS, an initiative by the Pentagon aimed at ensuring major U.S. military bases can function independently for 90 days in case of war-related disruptions. The climate of unease has been further exacerbated by recent cyberattacks that have targeted hundreds of companies and institutions worldwide, dubbed Black October" due to their widespread impact. The ripple effects of these service disruptions are being felt across various sectors, from finance to transportation. Companies like Chase and Wells Fargo experienced temporary issues with their systems, while United Airlines saw a significant delay in its operations due to technical problems. Experts suggest that the outages were caused by hasty network upgrades aimed at patching newly discovered vulnerabilities. However, officials have downplayed any connection to cyberattacks, attributing the disruptions to maintenance and technical changes instead. The Federal Aviation Administration's grounding of all planes for over four hours is a stark reminder of the impact these service interruptions can have on critical infrastructure. The agency later attributed the issue to an upgrade gone wrong, a copper wire being replaced with a fiber-optic cable. Internal communications networks are also under scrutiny, with the National Security Agency's internal classified network suffering an outage that has added to the sense of unease. The US economy is experiencing a perfect storm of disruptions that are causing widespread anxiety among consumers. The recent Microsoft Outlook outage has added to the sense of unease, making people question their ability to access essential services and information. In response to the growing uncertainty, some retailers have seen an increase in emergency supply sales. Costco and Walmart have reported higher demand for canned food, bottled water, and other essentials that are typically stocked up on during times of crisis. Analysts attribute this trend to consumer anxiety sparked by a series of high-profile outages and disruptions. The UK government has also weighed in with its own advice, urging citizens to prepare for potential disruptions by stockpiling cash, canned food, and bottled water. This message is being amplified across social media platforms, where apocalyptic concerns are spreading rapidly. The cumulative effect is a growing sense of unease among the general public. The stock market has not been immune to these developments, with investors taking a hit as fears about the end of the AI boom spread. The worst declines since the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic have left many wondering if the US economy is on the brink of collapse. The recent string of outages has left many concerned about the US economy's stability, and even officials at FEMA are taking notice. Mark Giles, director of Ookla Research, which owns Downdetector, pointed out that these events can have a significant impact on an economy. A power grid shutdown or airspace closure can be just as effective in crippling an economy as traditional warfare tactics, Giles noted. However, he emphasized that there is currently no evidence linking the recent outages. Most outages are self-contained and resolved quickly, but those that affect critical services like banking or email access tend to grab headlines. articles.title: Parenting Style Influenced by Large Family Upbringing
articles.summary: The author's childhood experience in a large family influenced their parenting style, which emphasizes compromise, generosity, and empathy.
articles.content: As a child of parents who married young and were still navigating adulthood themselves, I was part of a large family that was often chaotic but always loving. My three siblings and I had to learn to share space and resources, which taught us valuable lessons about compromise and generosity. Growing up in this environment also meant there was less individual attention from our parents, who were stretched thin trying to care for their young children. This scarcity of one-on-one time didn't seem to matter, however, as the love that flowed through our household came from multiple directions at once. When I became a stepmom myself at 25, I drew on this upbringing to inform my parenting style. Growing up in a large family taught me valuable lessons about human nature that have stayed with me to this day. My parents were responsible for making the rules and setting boundaries, but we children were also expected to look out for one another. Older siblings naturally took on a mentorship role, often unintentionally, as they navigated their own childhood challenges alongside ours. In our household, younger siblings learned quickly that it was essential to keep up with the rest of us in order to avoid being left behind. We witnessed each other's mistakes and heartbreaks firsthand, which taught me about empathy and compassion from a young age. This experience laid the groundwork for my understanding of human behavior, an education I would draw upon later as a parent myself. As I grew older and started a family of my own, I applied these lessons to my parenting style. Our four children, ranging in age from 16 to 32, have given me the opportunity to see how the world has changed over time. Parenting today is vastly different from what it was when I first started out in the late 1990s. Raising multiple children at once can be chaotic, with each child requiring individual attention and care. In a large family like ours, it's not always possible to give every child equal amounts of time and focus. However, my upbringing taught me how to observe and understand the needs of those around me, a skill that has proven invaluable as a parent. Growing up in a large family taught me that every child has unique needs and circumstances. In my household, it was often the quiet ones who required extra attention and care. As a parent, I've learned to look beyond what my children say and observe the subtle changes in their behavior. This skill has been invaluable in understanding what each of them truly requires from me. One child may thrive on lengthy conversations at midnight, while another needs space before opening up. Conversely, a rule that motivates one child can be suffocating for another. I've come to realize that consistency is essential, but rigidity is not always the best approach. This understanding has been shaped by my own experiences growing up in a family with five siblings. Each of us had distinct experiences and personalities, despite sharing parents and a home. Birth order, individual circumstances, and personality traits all contributed to our diverse childhoods. As a parent, I've applied this insight to understand that each of my children has their own unique experience within our family. As parents, it's natural to feel like every decision we make will have a lasting impact on our child's life. I recall feeling this way with my first child, where every milestone seemed monumental and every setback felt catastrophic. However, as the years went by and I had more children, I began to realize that life is unpredictable and things can change rapidly. What may seem like an insurmountable problem today might be resolved on its own tomorrow. This experience taught me to prioritize my concerns and intervene only when truly necessary. Raising four children also taught me the importance of being a supportive partner in parenting. With multiple kids, it's easy for disagreements and frustration to arise, but I learned that supporting each other through these challenges is crucial. By doing so, we became stronger as a couple and better equipped to navigate the ups and downs of parenthood. As I look back on my experience, I'm reminded that being a good parent isn't about trying to control every aspect of your child's life. It's about knowing when to step in and when to let things unfold naturally, and trusting that your children will learn and grow from their experiences, even if they make mistakes along the way. Parenting is not about providing identical experiences for each child, but rather adapting to their unique needs and personalities. At 25, I was a perfectionist mother who sought to prevent every mistake from occurring, whereas at 52, I've come to realize that mistakes often serve as valuable learning opportunities. This shift in perspective has allowed me to be more flexible and open-minded in my approach to parenting. As a child of six siblings myself, I learned early on about the importance of adapting and evolving with each new situation. Now, as a mother of four, I see that this same principle applies to raising children, sometimes it's necessary to pivot and try new approaches, even if they don't work for every child or in every circumstance. Raising multiple children requires an incredible amount of flexibility, patience, and understanding, but it also allows for growth and development on both the parent's and child's part. articles.title: Solar Panel Chargers Offer Alternative Power Source
articles.summary: A portable solar panel charger is an alternative power source that can be used in remote areas without access to electricity.
articles.content: When venturing into remote areas without access to electricity, it makes sense to have a backup power source for devices such as phones and laptops. Having a portable power bank can be beneficial in these situations but its capacity is limited and will eventually run out, potentially leaving you with a dead phone battery. In such instances, a solar panel charger could serve as an alternative solution. Solar-powered chargers come in various sizes and styles, from compact panels that can recharge small devices to larger units capable of powering laptops. They are particularly useful for individuals who frequently find themselves on the move or require an off-grid power source. To determine which type of charger is most suitable for your needs, you'll need to consider factors such as charging ports and built-in safety features. When selecting a solar-powered charging device, it's essential to consider your specific needs and usage patterns. A panel-only charger is ideal for short-term use, especially when sunlight is plentiful. This type of charger allows you to directly plug in devices like phones, but it has one major limitation: the power generated by the panels cannot be stored. For more extended periods or situations where sunlight may not always be available, a solar-powered charger with built-in batteries offers greater flexibility and convenience. These chargers enable you to store excess energy for later use, making them perfect for camping trips or other outdoor excursions where access to electricity might be limited. The option of using a portable power station is also worth considering, especially if you need to charge multiple devices simultaneously. Power stations usually come with built-in battery storage and can weigh as little as 4 pounds, depending on the model, making them relatively easy to transport. While more compact models may not offer the same level of capacity as larger units, they still provide a convenient solution for staying charged on the go. When choosing a portable solar charger, it's essential to weigh several factors beyond just wattage. The amount of power generated by a device can vary significantly depending on external conditions such as cloud cover or the angle at which it's positioned towards the sun. The number and type of ports available are also crucial considerations when selecting a portable solar charger. A convenient option is a device that allows direct connection via USB-C, eliminating the need for additional cables. However, some users may prefer devices with multiple ports to charge various devices simultaneously. In addition to portability and functionality, safety features are vital in ensuring optimal performance and durability. Many modern chargers come equipped with protective measures such as water and weather resistance, overcharge protection, and temperature control. These features can significantly extend the lifespan of a portable solar charger. Engadget : https://www.engadget.com/2318512/how-to-use-solar-panel-charge-phone/

This includes spills, crumbs, and bodily fluids, which can make them less appealing for someone looking to purchase a used seat. Donating damaged furniture can be challenging due to its condition. This makes it difficult to find a suitable recipient. Items with open packaging are also not suitable for donation. Many centers have strict protocols in place for accepting donated items, including toiletries and cosmetics that have been opened. articles.title: French Economist Hosts Summit in Paris After California Setback
articles.summary: Gabriel Zucman is hosting a summit in Paris on Saturday to discuss taxing billionaires.
articles.content: A French economist is taking his fight against billionaire tax avoidance to the global stage after a setback in California. Gabriel Zucman, who has spent over a decade developing ways to tax the ultra-rich, will host a summit in Paris on Saturday to confront what he calls "international oligarchy. This comes just weeks after California voters rejected a billionaire tax backed by Zucman. The campaign against it was heavily funded by tech mogul Sergey Brin and other opponents. Zucman views his loss as only a temporary setback, citing broad public support for taxing billionaires across the globe. He believes that even in defeat, progress can be made, pointing to recent midterm election results in the US where several Democrats who campaigned on taxing the ultra-rich won their seats. The French billionaire's fight for a minimum tax on the largest fortunes is gaining international attention, with left-wing leaders from Italy, Brazil, Spain, and the UK expected to attend an upcoming event. A key document in this effort is the Paris Manifesto, published just days ago, which outlines a comprehensive agenda for progressive change. The manifesto calls for a range of measures, including rules for artificial intelligence and protections for independent media. The question on everyone's mind is whether Zucman's ideas will resonate with policymakers outside France. His signature proposal, a minimum annual tax of 2% on the largest fortunes, was rejected by the French Senate last year, but he remains undeterred. Eva Joly, a prominent figure in French politics and a former European lawmaker for the Greens, has given her full-throated endorsement to Zucman's program. It's a real program to save our democracy," she declared, highlighting the urgent need for reform. As global talks on taxing the super-rich stall under the current US presidency of the G20, Zucman is looking ahead to next year when Britain takes over the rotating presidency and may be more receptive to his ideas. Tax reform efforts are gaining momentum across Europe as various countries explore ways to tackle corporate taxation and wealth inequality. In several European nations, including the Netherlands, Belgium, and Spain, bills are being drafted to target the wealthy, according to economist Gabriel Zucman. The British government is also beginning to consider implementing a similar measure. The issue of low taxes on multinationals was highlighted by an official who argued that such policies distort competition with domestic firms. This expert stressed that addressing this problem falls squarely within the purview of the European Commission and Parliament. European Council President António Costa is reportedly weighing a tax on US tech giants to fund the EU's next seven-year budget, following Trump's disappointing performance in the midterms which eased concerns about potential Washington retaliation. The French billionaire's proposal for a 2% wealth tax is gaining international attention following his defeat in California. Zucman has claimed that he had invited prominent figures from across Europe to support his idea, but both former EU competition chief Margrethe Vestager and former Italian Prime Minister Mario Draghi declined the invitation. In France, however, Zucman's proposed 2% annual wealth tax has found some supporters among left-wing parties ahead of next spring's presidential election. The far-left France Unbowed party and the Greens have fully endorsed his proposal. François Geerolf, an economist at Sciences Po's OFCE, has questioned the merits of Zucman's plan in a recent paper, arguing that it could do more harm than good by imposing an annual tax on fortunes rather than closing loopholes used by billionaires to shield their income from taxation. The criticism against Zucman's tax plan continues to grow, with some experts questioning its potential impact on France's economy. Estimates suggesting the tax would raise €20 billion annually in France have been disputed by economists, who argue that the actual proceeds could be significantly lower, ranging from €2 billion to €6 billion per year. A campaign group backed by business executive Eric Maumy has also weighed in against Zucman's plan, releasing a study that characterizes it as confiscatory and unconstitutional. articles.title: Meta Employees Raise Concerns Over Muse AI Agent's Data Access and Security Protocols
articles.summary: Internal posts among Meta employees have revealed concerns regarding the company's Muse AI agent sending unwarranted notifications into their private lives.
articles.content: Internal posts at Meta have revealed concerns among employees regarding the company's Muse AI agent, which has been sending unwarranted notifications into their private lives. One employee reported receiving a reminder on her personal phone to respond to a message from her sister on Signal, an encrypted messaging service that is supposed to be secure. This intrusion has left many questioning how Muse accessed this information without explicit permission. The employee's words echo the sentiment of others who are now reevaluating their trust in the AI agent. Several employees have shared instances where Muse initiated chats about apps they had not connected or authorized, sparking concerns over data access and security protocols. It appears that by default, Muse was set up to receive push notifications on Android phones without explicit user consent. This has raised alarms among Meta staff who are now scrutinizing the AI's capabilities. Some employees have shared particularly unsettling examples of Muse's behavior, including an unsolicited mention of their bank balances during a conversation about fishing-related weather and tide information. Other random messages from Muse have also caught workers off guard, with some raising concerns over potential data breaches and unauthorized access to sensitive information. Meta's internal testing of its AI agent Muse has raised concerns among employees about potential data breaches and unauthorized access to sensitive information. The Superintelligence team member pointed out that the hallucinations, which are essentially incorrect or made-up responses from the AI, tend to focus on uncomfortable topics such as finances, security, and safety. These hallucinations can also delve into cryptocurrency-related matters, including providing updates on Bitcoin balances. This has left employees uneasy about the potential implications of these interactions. The company's response to the issue emphasizes that employee testing is a crucial aspect of product development, aimed at gathering feedback to implement privacy safeguards. However, this explanation does little to alleviate concerns about the AI's ability to access sensitive information without proper authorization. Meta maintains that employees have access to different versions of Muse than the public, and some functions are not available elsewhere, which may be intended to mitigate potential risks. Nevertheless, the company acknowledges that users must opt in for certain features, such as notification access on Android devices or screen recording permissions on Macs. Muse's rapid growth has not gone unnoticed by other companies, which are taking steps to block its access to sensitive information. Some of these companies include major financial institutions like JPMorgan Chase and Wells Fargo, as well as technology giants such as Amazon and Apple. These firms are implementing measures to prevent Muse from accessing customer accounts or acting on their behalf, a move that reflects growing concerns about the potential risks associated with AI agents. In addition to blocking access to sensitive information, these companies are also experiencing technical difficulties related to network upgrades. The outages affecting Meta's employees are not necessarily connected to other technical issues, according to Mark Giles, director of Ookla Research. Giles notes that these disruptions are relatively common and usually resolved quickly, but it's the severity of their impact that grabs attention, such as when critical services like withdrawing money or accessing emails become unavailable. articles.title: Karnataka Defeat Railways by Three Runs to Win Maiden Women's T20 Trophy Title
articles.summary: Karnataka won their first-ever Women's T20 Trophy title after defeating defending champions Railways by three runs at the Narendra Modi Stadium B ground in Ahmedabad.
articles.content: Karnataka has pulled off a stunning upset to claim their maiden Women's T20 Trophy title, defeating defending champions Railways by three runs in a last-ball thriller at the Narendra Modi Stadium B ground in Ahmedabad. The Karnataka team made a brisk start with the bat, reaching 54/2 at the end of the powerplay, thanks in part to an impressive opening partnership between Shubha and Niki Prasad. The two batsmen put on 43 crucial runs for the second wicket, laying the foundation for their team's total. Shubha led from the front with a composed innings that proved decisive in taking Karnataka to 149/8. Her 39-ball 48 was a standout performance, one that showed her ability to adapt and thrive under pressure. The rest of the Karnataka batsmen also chipped in with valuable contributions. Railways' bowlers fought hard to keep their team in contention, with Poonam Yadav and Sneh Rana keeping things tight in the latter stages. Despite a strong effort from their top-order batsmen, Railways ultimately fell short, losing by three runs on the last ball of the match. Karnataka's bowling unit started strongly as Monica Patil conceded just six runs in her first two overs. She also managed to dismiss the aggressive Sneh Rana after being hit for two successive boundaries earlier on. This breakthrough was a crucial moment in the match, and it seemed to give Karnataka an upper hand. Back-to-back wickets in the eighth and ninth overs further restricted Railways' scoring rate, leaving them at 61/3 by the halfway stage of the match. The momentum had shifted firmly in Karnataka's favour, and they sensed an opportunity to push for a win. BG Tejashwini's dismissal of Minnu Mani in the 16th over added more pressure on Railways. The turning point came when BG Tejashwini returned in the 18th over and picked up two crucial wickets. She first accounted for Kaushalya Choudhary, followed by Arushi Goel, which swung the match decisively in Karnataka's favour. With a strong finish in sight, Shubha turned to Rajeshwari Gayakwad to defend 18 runs in the final over. Rajeshwari Gayakwad held her nerve and delivered under pressure, securing a memorable victory for Karnataka. The team erupted into celebrations as they tasted their maiden Women's T20 Trophy title. In an emotional interview with TOI, Shubha expressed her gratitude to the entire support staff, particularly head coach SN Ameet, who she credited with the team's success. The Karnataka team's maiden Women's T20 Trophy win has marked the beginning of a promising era for women's cricket in the state. Shubha expressed her gratitude to the entire support staff who contributed to their success. The KSCA Maharani Trophy T20 tournament played under lights at the M Chinnaswamy Stadium provided valuable exposure and helped the team cope with pressure, according to Shubha. She credited the competition for preparing them for the challenge they faced in the Women's T20 Trophy. KSCA president Venkatesh Prasad hailed the achievement as a phenomenal milestone for women's cricket in Karnataka, highlighting the importance of providing competitive platforms for female cricketers. The win demonstrates that with a good platform like the Maharani Trophy, results will eventually follow when players are given the opportunity to perform at their best. articles.title: Airlines Introduce Upgrades in Economy Class
articles.summary: Airlines are upgrading economy class amenities without breaking the bank, focusing on making flights more enjoyable.
articles.content: Airline upgrades in economy class are receiving attention, but not to the same extent as premium seating. While first-class and business-class amenities have dominated headlines, airlines are quietly introducing innovations in economy, improving the overall flying experience without breaking the bank. United's Polaris Studios, which debuted earlier this year with 27-inch screens, is one example of a luxury feature now available to passengers who opt for premium seats. This trend has led airlines to focus on upgrading their economy offerings as well. In recent times, some airlines have started rolling out new options and upgrades in economy, making flights more enjoyable without requiring a hefty price tag or points redemption. Airline loyalty program members can now enjoy complimentary onboard internet access thanks to initiatives from various carriers. This perk is being extended to their loyal customers as a token of appreciation for their continued support. Airlines are revamping their in-flight entertainment offerings to provide passengers with seamless connectivity. The Wi-Fi experience on commercial flights is set to undergo a significant upgrade. Starlink, considered the fastest Wi-Fi in the sky today, is being installed or prepared for installation by several airlines. This cutting-edge technology will enable passengers to stay connected and entertained throughout their journey without interruptions. Ultrafast internet access is becoming increasingly available on flights. Sleeping comfortably while traveling coach has long been a challenge for many passengers. To address this issue, Emirates recently introduced its "U-Dream setup featuring adjustable side wings that support the neck during sleep. This innovative feature aims to reduce discomfort and promote restful slumber. Airlines are also experimenting with new ways to provide passengers with food and beverage options while in flight. Walk-up snack bars have begun appearing on some commercial planes, allowing passengers to stretch their legs and grab a bite to eat at 35,000 feet. United Airlines has opted to reserve the final row of its new Airbus A321XLR for a snack bar, providing passengers on long-haul flights in this single-aisle aircraft with an added convenience. Several major carriers have announced plans to introduce their own in-flight snack bars in the near future, indicating that this trend is likely to become more widespread in the coming months and years. JetBlue has been offering a pantry-style snack area on its longer-range planes for some time now, providing passengers with easy access to a variety of snacks and beverages during their flight. Some airlines are going even further by incorporating more comfortable seating options into their economy class cabins, such as United's upcoming Relax Row product, which features a couch-like setup designed specifically for families traveling together. Air New Zealand is set to introduce a new feature in its economy class cabins that could revolutionize long-haul travel: bunk beds. The innovative Skynest concept will provide passengers with two sets of stacked bunks, each three high, accessible via a ladder. This unique design allows for greater comfort and flexibility, particularly on ultra-long journeys where sleep is crucial. Passengers can book a four-hour nap in one of these cozy bunk beds for an additional fee of $495 - a small price to pay for a much-needed rest after hours of flying. The introduction of such amenities is part of a broader trend among airlines to upgrade their economy class offerings. Whether it's through more comfortable seating options or innovative features like bunk beds, passengers are being treated to a more luxurious experience without having to break the bank. Qantas is also taking steps to enhance its economy class experience with the launch of Project Sunrise, a new service that will operate on ultra-long-range Airbus A350-1000 aircraft. The major US airlines are upgrading their seatback entertainment systems to keep up with changing passenger expectations. United Airlines has been equipping its seatback devices with Bluetooth pairing technology, allowing passengers to connect their wireless headphones directly to the screens. This upgrade enables flyers to enjoy their favorite music and movies on their Apple AirPods or similar devices without any cables getting in the way. The carrier's new partnership with Spotify also lets passengers stream from their accounts directly on the seatback screen, providing a seamless entertainment experience. Delta Air Lines is taking its seatback entertainment to the next level by partnering with YouTube, offering an extensive library of content for passengers to enjoy during flights. The airline is also gearing up to introduce new, state-of-the-art screens equipped with innovative features that will further enhance the in-flight experience. American Airlines is reviving its seatback entertainment system after removing it from its planes several years ago. Although it may take some time before these upgraded screens become widely available on all American flights, passengers can look forward to a more enjoyable and engaging travel experience. Airline screens are being upgraded to provide a more enjoyable in-flight experience for passengers. The outdated communal screens that once dominated the cabin will soon be replaced with personal entertainment systems on select flights, offering a wider range of movies and TV shows. This is a game-changer," said an airline executive, acknowledging the shift towards individualized entertainment options. Passengers can now choose from a library of content that includes popular films, TV series, music, and games. These upgraded screens will also provide faster loading times and improved navigation, making it easier for passengers to find their favorite shows or browse through the available content. articles.title: Windows Has Two GPUs: How to Identify Them
articles.summary: The Task Manager is one of the quickest ways to find out which GPU your system uses for certain tasks, but Windows offers other built-in options as well.
articles.content: When upgrading or troubleshooting your Windows PC, knowing the type of graphics processing unit (GPU) installed is crucial for making informed decisions. Many users don't realize that their computer can have two GPUs: one integrated into the CPU and another dedicated GPU, often from NVIDIA, AMD, or Intel, which handles demanding tasks like gaming. The system's performance and capabilities may not be entirely clear just by looking at an Intel or AMD sticker on the device. To identify the GPU in your Windows PC, you don't need to open it up or install any external software. Instead, there are built-in tools that can provide this information quickly and easily. However, these tools may only reveal details if they're not hidden in fine print. The Task Manager is one of the quickest ways to find out which GPU your system uses for certain tasks. But besides this tool, Windows offers other built-in options as well, which are useful when you need more detailed information about your graphics hardware. The Performance section of Windows' Task Manager offers a clear view into your computer's graphics card, including details about its memory, driver, and current workload. Windows labels GPUs based on their hardware location, not their performance, which means the numbering doesn't necessarily reflect the more powerful or primary graphics card. Below the performance graphs in Task Manager, you'll find dedicated and shared GPU memory. Dedicated memory refers to the VRAM available on a dedicated GPU, while shared memory is system RAM borrowed by the GPU when needed. Some integrated GPUs reserve a portion of system RAM for graphics, which Windows reports as dedicated memory, but an integrated GPU relies heavily on system RAM rather than having its own dedicated memory. Task Manager also provides additional details about your GPU, including branding, driver information, DirectX version, and even temperature readings if the hardware supports it. To view your GPU's name without any graphs involved, head to Device Manager by right-clicking the Start button and selecting it from the list. To get more detailed information about your system's graphics card, you can open the DirectX Diagnostic Tool from the Run dialog box. Pressing Windows + R will bring up the Run dialog box, where you can type dxdiag and press Enter to launch the tool. This will give you access to a range of tabs that provide details about your system's hardware and software configuration. The Display tab within the DirectX Diagnostic Tool provides information on the graphics card installed in your system, as well as its drivers, while the System tab shows the version of DirectX installed on your system.
